name: the-italian-club-functions
description: Notifications that reach a phone with the app closed. The only code in this project that does not run on a phone.
//overrides: uuid is forced to the patched 11.1.1 for EVERY package that asks for it. Nothing here depends on uuid directly: it arrives under firebase-admin, and gaxios (^9.0.1) and teeny-request (^9.0.0) still pin the range GHSA flags (missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when a buf is passed). Both call ONLY uuid.v4() and pass no buf, so the flaw was never reachable here — this removes a standing alert, it does not close a hole. Upgrading firebase-admin does NOT help: 14.3.0 still carries the same chain, and it is the current release. Re-verified on firebase-admin 14.3.0: those are the only two askers left in package-lock.json (google-gax has dropped out of the tree since this note was written), uuid resolves to 11.1.1 and returns valid v4 ids. Drop this override once Google's libraries stop asking for uuid 9 — check package-lock.json for who still does, do not trust this sentence.
